question: How can action occur even among beings not normally acting in those regions?
premises: In those regions the status of action-land applies only predominantly.
Even non-acting beings such as animals may be present there.
A karmic impression can arise in them due to firm prior conditioning.
inference: Although those regions are mainly lands of enjoyment, firm prior conditioning can produce karmic impressions even in animals.
uncertainties: The scope of 'atra' may refer to the previously named regions or to the general cosmological context.
plain_english: In those regions, although they are mainly not lands of action, even animals may acquire karmic impressions because of firmly established prior conditioning.
